title: Prompt: pick a value from the lookup window
description: Template (T10.2). A GeneXus Prompt: a button next to a field opens a window with a list, and picking a row fills the field of the form. This template assumes the prompt opens INSIDE the page (a popup layer with an iframe, which is what the frame step reaches by a part of its URL). A prompt that opens a separate browser window is not reachable by these steps: change the prompt's window mode in the model or test it through its URL. Logs in, opens the form, opens the prompt, filters it with a known value, picks the first row and checks that the form now shows the description of what was picked. It only reads; nothing is saved. Replace every REPLACE_* value. See templates/routines/README.md.

lintSuppress.reason: The logout is the teardown of the included login routine.

steps.label: Open the form that has the prompt
The prompt button is on screen
The prompt's filter is on screen, inside its window
Type the value to look for, in the prompt
Wait for the prompt's grid (any frame counts)
The prompt lists at least one row
The prompt closed and the form updated
The form shows the description of the row that was picked
No stack trace or SQL error on screen
